record.question: In the given arrangement, how many such letters are there which are immediately preceded by a symbol and immediately followed by a number?
record.explanation: Read the restored sequence one symbol at a time. The only letter with a symbol immediately before it and a number immediately after it is Q in @ Q 9. V has $ before it but M after it, and R has * before it but ? after it, so neither qualifies. The count is 1. Verified solution (unofficial); original printed paper and worked derivation checked on 26 October 2026.
